title: Developer Onboarding Automation CLI
description: Built a modular TypeScript CLI (dev-setup) to standardize developer onboarding with a single init command that composes the other checks, reporting whether Node.js, pnpm, and Docker meet minimum versions (with per-tool --require/--skip flags for CI), generating .env files from .env.example without overwriting existing ones, reporting missing or unused environment variables with a CI-friendly exit code, and scaffolding new TypeScript projects from an editable template embedded into the binary at build time. Designed a layered commands → services → adapters architecture that keeps external systems isolated, plus a build-time code generator that registers commands through static imports so they bundle cleanly into standalone Windows, macOS, and Linux binaries with Deno. Enforced quality through a GitHub Actions PR policy requiring passing tests, at least 80% coverage on changed files, JSDoc on every changed export, and up-to-date documentation. In progress: installing missing dependencies and starting the dev environment from dev-setup init.
